subject: chemistry
title: Bohr model & hydrogen spectrum
description: Electron jumps n₂ → n₁ emit a photon: 1/λ = R Z²(1/n₁² − 1/n₂²). Balmer lines are visible.

subject: chemistry
title: Electron configuration (Aufbau, Hund, Pauli)
description: Orbital box diagram for Z = 1–54 with Cr, Cu, Mo, Ag exceptions.

subject: chemistry
title: Shapes of atomic orbitals
description: 1: s · 2–4: p_x, p_y, p_z · 5: d_xy · 6: d_xz · 7: d_x²−y² · 8: d_z². Rotate to see 3D lobes and phases.

subject: chemistry
title: Periodic table & periodic trends
description: Categories or heat maps of electronegativity, ionisation energy and atomic radius (Z ≤ 36).

subject: chemistry
title: Trend graph across periods
description: Bars of the chosen property for Z = 1–36; note the peaks at noble gases and dips at alkali metals.

subject: chemistry
title: Moles, molar mass & Avogadro number
description: n = m / M and N = n·Nₐ for a sample of an element.

subject: chemistry
title: VSEPR molecular shapes
description: 13 shapes from linear to octahedral with lone pairs and bond angles; rotate in 3D.

subject: chemistry
title: Bond polarity & ionic character
description: ΔEN between two atoms; % ionic ≈ 100(1 − e^(−ΔEN²/4)) (Pauling).

subject: chemistry
title: Gas laws  PV = nRT
description: Charles (V ∝ T), Boyle (V ∝ 1/P) and Avogadro (V ∝ n) in a piston.

subject: chemistry
title: Maxwell–Boltzmann speed distribution
description: f(v) at two temperatures; hotter gas spreads to higher speeds, peak at v_mp = √(2RT/M).

subject: chemistry
title: Real gas: van der Waals isotherm
description: P = RT/(V − b) − a/V² compared with the ideal gas (CO₂ default a, b).

subject: chemistry
title: Graham's law of diffusion
description: Rate ∝ 1/√M: lighter gases spread faster along the tube.

subject: chemistry
title: Energy profile: exo/endothermic & catalyst
description: ΔH = E(products) − E(reactants); activation energy Eₐ and the lower catalysed path.

subject: chemistry
title: Gibbs free energy & spontaneity
description: ΔG = ΔH − TΔS; the reaction becomes (non-)spontaneous at T = ΔH/ΔS.

subject: chemistry
title: Heating water (calorimetry, engine)
description: dT/dt = P/(mc); temperature plateaus at the boiling point.

subject: chemistry
title: First-order reaction A → B (engine)
description: d[A]/dt = −k[A]; half-life t½ = ln 2/k is constant.

subject: chemistry
title: Zero, first & second order rate laws
description: d[A]/dt = −k[A]ⁿ; compare [A], ln[A] and 1/[A] for the straight-line test.

subject: chemistry
title: Arrhenius equation
description: k = A e^(−Eₐ/RT); a 10 K rise roughly doubles k for typical Eₐ.

subject: chemistry
title: A + B → C (second order, engine)
description: d[C]/dt = k[A][B]; the limiting reagent runs out first.

subject: chemistry
title: Reversible reaction A ⇌ B (engine)
description: Forward and backward rates become equal; Q → K = k_f/k_b.

subject: chemistry
title: Le Chatelier's principle (add reactant)
description: At time t₁ extra A is added; the system shifts forward to restore Q = K.

subject: chemistry
title: ICE table: H₂ + I₂ ⇌ 2HI
description: Solves (2x)² / ((a − x)(b − x)) = K for the equilibrium amounts.

equations.expression: abs(q) < 1e-6 ? a b/(a + b) : (-K (a + b) + sqrt(K^2 (a + b)^2 + 4 q K a b))/(2 q)

results.label: x

subject: chemistry
title: pH scale & universal indicator
description: Strong acid or base of concentration C (water autoionisation included).

subject: chemistry
title: Acid–base titration
description: NaOH from the burette into acid: strong (HCl) or weak (CH₃COOH, pKa 4.76) titration curve and indicator colour.

equations.expression: nB == 0 ? (-Ka + sqrt(Ka^2 + 4 Ka Ca))/2 : nB < nA ? Ka (nA - nB)/nB : nB == nA ? 1e-14/sqrt((1e-14/Ka) (nA/Vt)) : 1e-14/((nB - nA)/Vt)

results.label: Hw

subject: chemistry
title: Buffer: Henderson–Hasselbalch
description: pH = pKa + log([A⁻]/[HA]); the buffer works best near pH = pKa.

subject: chemistry
title: Daniell cell & Nernst equation
description: Zn | Zn²⁺ ‖ Cu²⁺ | Cu: E = E° − (RT/2F) ln([Zn²⁺]/[Cu²⁺]); electrons flow Zn → Cu.

subject: chemistry
title: Electrolysis: Faraday's laws
description: Mass deposited m = M·I·t / (z·F); copper plates the cathode.

subject: biology
title: Cell structure: animal vs plant
description: Organelles with labels: 1 membrane · 2 nucleus · 3 nucleolus · 4 RER · 5 Golgi · 6 mitochondrion · 7 lysosome · 8 centrioles · 9 wall · 10 vacuole · 11 chloroplast.

subject: biology
title: Surface area : volume ratio
description: SA/V = 6/L for a cube: why cells stay small.

subject: biology
title: Mitosis: stages of cell division
description: Interphase → prophase → metaphase → anaphase → telophase → cytokinesis (2n = 4).

subject: biology
title: Enzyme kinetics (Michaelis–Menten)
description: v = Vmax[S]/(Km + [S]); a competitive inhibitor raises the apparent Km.

subject: biology
title: Osmosis across a membrane (engine)
description: Water moves toward the higher solute concentration until hydrostatic pressure balances.

subject: biology
title: Monohybrid cross (Punnett square)
description: Parent genotypes 0 AA · 1 Aa · 2 aa; complete or incomplete dominance (red × white → pink).

subject: biology
title: Dihybrid cross (9 : 3 : 3 : 1)
description: Two independently assorting genes; AaBb × AaBb gives 9 : 3 : 3 : 1.

subject: biology
title: Hardy–Weinberg equilibrium
description: p² + 2pq + q² = 1 for allele frequencies p and q.

subject: biology
title: DNA double helix
description: Antiparallel strands, complementary base pairing, 10 bp per turn (3.4 nm).

subject: biology
title: Translation: codons → amino acids
description: The ribosome reads mRNA codon by codon from AUG to a stop codon, building the polypeptide.

subject: biology
title: Photosynthesis & limiting factors
description: Rate limited by light, CO₂ or temperature (Blackman); count O₂ bubbles from Hydrilla.

subject: biology
title: Water potential & plasmolysis
description: Water moves from higher to lower ψ; in hypertonic solution the protoplast shrinks.

subject: biology
title: Cardiac cycle & cardiac output
description: CO = HR × SV; ventricular volume falls in systole and refills in diastole.

subject: biology
title: Nerve impulse & action potential
description: The impulse travels along the axon; the electrode at the middle records the action potential.

subject: biology
title: Oxygen–haemoglobin dissociation curve
description: Sigmoid Hill curve; higher CO₂, H⁺ or temperature raise P₅₀ (Bohr shift to the right).

subject: biology
title: Blood glucose regulation by insulin (engine)
description: After a meal glucose rises; insulin secretion brings it back (negative feedback).

subject: biology
title: Population growth: exponential vs logistic (engine)
description: dN/dt = rN (J-curve) or rN(1 − N/K) (S-curve, carrying capacity K).

equations.expression: model == 1 ? r N : r N (1 - N/K)

subject: biology
title: Predator–prey (Lotka–Volterra, engine)
description: Prey: αx − βxy · Predators: δxy − γy. Oscillations lag a quarter cycle.

subject: biology
title: Energy flow: ecological pyramid
description: Lindeman's 10 % law: energy available at each trophic level.

subject: biology
title: Natural selection: peppered moth (engine)
description: On soot-darkened bark, birds eat light moths; the dark allele rises over generations.

subject: biology
title: PCR amplification
description: Copies = N₀(1 + E)ⁿ: exponential doubling with each cycle.

subject: biology
title: Gel electrophoresis
description: DNA (negative) moves to the anode; smaller fragments travel farther (∝ −log size).

subject: mathematics
title: Straight line y = mx + c
description: Slope m and intercept c; slope triangle and x-intercept.

subject: mathematics
title: Quadratic function & its roots
description: Vertex, axis of symmetry, discriminant D and real roots.

subject: mathematics
title: Cubic polynomial from its roots
description: y = a(x − p)(x − q)(x − r): drag a root and watch the graph.

subject: mathematics
title: Two linear equations (intersection)
description: a₁x + b₁y = c₁ and a₂x + b₂y = c₂: unique, none or infinite solutions.

subject: mathematics
title: Complex numbers on the Argand plane
description: z = r(cos φ + i sin φ), conjugate and De Moivre power zⁿ.

subject: mathematics
title: Transformations  a·f(b(x − h)) + k
description: Parent 1:x² 2:|x| 3:√x 4:x³ 5:sin x 6:2ˣ — stretch, shift and reflect.

subject: mathematics
title: Exponential & logarithm (inverse functions)
description: y = aˣ and y = logₐx are mirror images in y = x.

subject: mathematics
title: Rational function & asymptotes
description: y = (ax + b)/(cx + d): vertical asymptote x = −d/c, horizontal y = a/c.

subject: mathematics
title: Modulus of a function |f(x)|
description: Parts below the x-axis are reflected upward.

subject: mathematics
title: Unit circle → sine graph
description: sin θ, cos θ, tan θ on the unit circle, traced out as the sine curve.

subject: mathematics
title: y = A sin(Bx + C) + D
description: Amplitude, period 2π/B, phase shift and vertical shift.

subject: mathematics
title: Graphs of sin, cos and tan
description: All three graphs with a moving vertical reading line.

subject: mathematics
title: Heights & distances
description: Angle of elevation α = tan⁻¹(h/d) from an observer to the top of a tower.

subject: mathematics
title: Distance, midpoint & section formula
description: AB = √((x₂−x₁)²+(y₂−y₁)²), midpoint M and the point dividing AB in m : n.

subject: mathematics
title: Circle (x − h)² + (y − k)² = r²
description: Centre, radius and a point moving on the circle.

subject: mathematics
title: Parabola: focus & directrix
description: x² = 4ay: every point is equidistant from focus (0, a) and directrix y = −a.

subject: mathematics
title: Ellipse: sum of focal distances
description: x²/a² + y²/b² = 1, foci (±c, 0), PF₁ + PF₂ = 2a.

equations.expression: sqrt((px - c)^2 + py^2) + sqrt((px + c)^2 + py^2)

results.label: S
results.expression: sqrt((px - c)^2 + py^2) + sqrt((px + c)^2 + py^2)

subject: mathematics
title: Hyperbola: difference of focal distances
description: x²/a² − y²/b² = 1 with asymptotes y = ±(b/a)x, |PF₁ − PF₂| = 2a.

equations.expression: abs(sqrt((px - c)^2 + py^2) - sqrt((px + c)^2 + py^2))

results.label: Df
results.expression: abs(sqrt((px - c)^2 + py^2) - sqrt((px + c)^2 + py^2))

subject: mathematics
title: Derivative: secant → tangent
description: Slope of the secant (f(a+h) − f(a))/h approaches f′(a) as h → 0.

subject: mathematics
title: Area under a curve – Riemann sums
description: Left, right, midpoint or trapezoid sums converge to the definite integral as n grows.

subject: mathematics
title: Maxima & minima
description: f(x) = x³ − 3px + q: stationary points where f′(x) = 0; f′ shown dashed.

subject: mathematics
title: Limit: sin x / x as x → 0
description: Approach x = 0 from both sides; the value tends to 1 though f(0) is undefined.

subject: mathematics
title: Differential equation dy/dx = ax − y
description: Slope field with the RK4 solution curve traced from y(0) = y₀.

subject: mathematics
title: Vector addition (triangle & parallelogram)
description: a + b by the triangle law with the parallelogram completed.

subject: mathematics
title: Dot product & projection
description: a·b = |a||b|cos θ and the projection of b on a.

subject: mathematics
title: 3D vector & its components
description: v = xî + yĵ + zk̂ with |v| = √(x²+y²+z²); rotate the view.

subject: mathematics
title: Linear transformation by a 2×2 matrix
description: Columns are the images of î and ĵ; the unit square maps to area |det|.

subject: mathematics
title: Mensuration of 3D solids
description: Cylinder πr²h, cone ⅓πr²h, sphere ⁴⁄₃πr³ — rotate and compare.

subject: mathematics
title: Arithmetic progression
description: aₙ = a + (n − 1)d and Sₙ = n/2 (2a + (n − 1)d).

subject: mathematics
title: Geometric progression & infinite sum
description: Partial sums Sₙ of a GP; for |r| < 1 they converge to a/(1 − r).

subject: mathematics
title: Fibonacci numbers & the golden ratio
description: Ratio Fₙ₊₁/Fₙ converges to φ = (1 + √5)/2 (Binet formula).

subject: mathematics
title: Binomial distribution
description: P(X = k) = ⁿCₖ pᵏ(1 − p)ⁿ⁻ᵏ with mean np and variance np(1 − p).

equations.expression: K <= n ? combinations(n, K) p^K (1 - p)^(n - K) : 0

results.expression: K <= n ? combinations(n, K) p^K (1 - p)^(n - K) : 0

subject: mathematics
title: Normal distribution – area between z₁ and z₂
description: Shaded probability P(z₁ < Z < z₂) using the error function.

subject: mathematics
title: Sum of two dice
description: Probability distribution of the sum; the current outcome is highlighted.

subject: mathematics
title: Coin tosses – law of large numbers
description: Running percentage of heads settles near 50 % as N grows.
